name: Benefits — PAR surgery: deductible and OOP maximum met, pay the allowed amount in full
description: Twenty guided steps built from the Benefits.5 story: price the line, work through the 5Ws of Benefit (the provider's specialty and participation, the procedure, the date of service, the claim type and place of service, the diagnosis) with Code Set lookups, find the Surgery Service → Professional service-level benefit for the PAR provider, check the out-of-pocket limits and the accumulators, calculate what the member owes, validate to apply the benefits and confirm them on Claim Lines, then pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure
steps.description: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure. Open the Search tab, then the Pricing sub-tab, scroll down to the Claim lines section and click Get Pricing. The allowed amount then shows in the Allowed column. Review it together with the Billed amount (the bill charge) and the Write-off: the allowed amount is the bill charge less the write-off. For procedure 21933 the bill charge is $1,500.00, the allowed amount is $800.00 and the write-off is $700.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Get Pricing is clicked in Search → Pricing.
steps.hint: Search tab → Pricing sub-tab → Claim lines → Get Pricing. Allowed = Billed − Write-off.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the allowed amount for the procedure

steps.name: Who — check the provider specialty
steps.description: Start the 5Ws of Benefit, which decide the right benefit for the claim. The first W is Who. Open the Provider Info tab and, in the Rendering section, read the Speciality and Speciality description fields: the provider's specialty is AMBULATORY SURGERY CENTER (049).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Provider Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Provider Info → Rendering → Speciality and Speciality description: AMBULATORY SURGERY CENTER.

steps.name: Who — confirm provider participation
steps.description: Continue the Who review on the Claim Header tab. In the General Claim Data section, the Provider Participation field reads PAR: the provider participates in the network, so the PAR benefits apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Header → General Claim Data → Provider Participation: PAR.

steps.name: What — identify the procedure code
steps.description: The next W is What. Open the Claim Lines tab and find the procedure code on line 1: 21933. You look it up in Code Set next.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Procedure: 21933.

steps.name: What — review the procedure code details
steps.description: Look up the procedure code. Open the Search tab, then the Code Set sub-tab. Procedure Code (Px) is already selected in Select Code Type and 21933 is in Enter Code, with the search already performed. Note the description — EXCISION, TUMOR, SOFT TISSUE OF BACK OR FLANK, SUBFASCIAL (EG, INTRAMUSCULAR); 5 CM OR GREATER — and the service classes 17 (SURGERY) and 172 (AIM SERVICES). Together they tell you the service billed: a surgical excision of a soft-tissue tumour.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Code Set sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Search tab → Code Set sub-tab. The 21933 lookup is already shown.
steps.checklistItem: What — review the procedure code details

steps.name: When — note the date of service
steps.description: The next W is When. Go back to the Claim Lines tab and read the date of service on line 1 from its From date and To columns: 02/23/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → From date and To: 02/23/2026.
steps.checklistItem: When — note the date of service

steps.name: Where — check the claim type
steps.description: The next W is Where: where the service was performed. Start with the claim type. Open the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and in the Additional Claim Data section read the Claim type field: PA - Professional.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Data → Details sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Data → Details → Additional Claim Data → Claim type: PA - Professional.

steps.name: Where — note the place of service
steps.description: Check the place of service on the claim. On the Claim Lines tab, the POS field on line 1 reads 24.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → POS: 24.
steps.checklistItem: Where — note the place of service

steps.name: Where — confirm the POS description
steps.description: Look up the POS code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Place of Service (POS) in Select Code Type. Line 1's code, 24, fills in and its result shows straight away: the description is Home.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the POS 24 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Place of Service (POS), or by searching that type for 24.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Place of Service (POS). POS 24 is Home.

steps.name: Why — identify the diagnosis code
steps.description: The final W is Why. On the Claim Lines tab, find the diagnosis code on line 1: R222.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Claim Lines → Line 1 → Diagnosis: R222.

steps.name: Why — review the diagnosis code details
steps.description: Look up the diagnosis code. Open Search → Code Set and choose Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10) in Select Code Type. Line 1's diagnosis, R222, fills in and the search is applied: the description is LOCALIZED SWELLING, MASS AND LUMP, TRUNK, and the Limit class table lists V19 (VA EMTALA-ER MED TRMT ACT) and 021 (OUT OF AREA EMERGENCY).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the R222 lookup is shown in Code Set — by choosing Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10), or by searching that type for R222.
steps.hint: Search → Code Set → Select Code Type: Diagnosis Code (Dx - ICD-10).
steps.checklistItem: Why — review the diagnosis code details

steps.name: Open the benefits for the contract
steps.description: With the 5Ws complete — an Ambulatory Surgery Center that is PAR, procedure 21933 on 02/23/2026, a PA - Professional claim at POS 24 (Home), diagnosis R222 — check the benefits that apply. Open the Search tab, then the Benefits sub-tab, and make sure the date of service, 02/23/2026, falls inside the contract's Effective date and End date (01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999).
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Benefits sub-tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Search tab → Benefits sub-tab. 02/23/2026 falls inside 01/01/2026 – 12/31/9999.
steps.checklistItem: Open the benefits for the contract

steps.name: Locate the benefit category and subcategory
steps.description: Click + next to Service level to open the benefit categories, listed under a Benefits Category search box. Open the Benefit Hierarchy Service Categories Document to identify the Major Category and subcategory to select as per the Procedure details previously identified. From the details you noted, the major category is Surgery Service and the subcategory is Professional. The procedure decides the category: 21933 is an excision, and its service class is 17 - SURGERY, so the benefit sits under Surgery Service. The claim type decides the subcategory: this is a PA - Professional claim, so it is Professional, not Facility. Expand Surgery Service with its arrow to show its subcategories, Facility and Professional, then expand Professional to show the additional categories beneath it: Assistant Surgeon, Bariatric, Biopsy, Endoscopic Surgery, Eye Surgery, Foot Care, Oral Surgery, Reproductive Surgery, Reconstructive Surgery, Transplants and TMJ. Check whether any of them fits the procedure, an excision of a soft-tissue tumour of the back. None does, so Professional under Surgery Service is the benefit to use.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Professional is expanded under Surgery Service. Expanding Surgery Service itself, or any other category, completes nothing.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Service level → expand Surgery Service → expand Professional. Service class 17 - SURGERY picks Surgery Service; the PA - Professional claim picks Professional.
steps.checklistItem: Locate the benefit category and subcategory

steps.name: Review the Surgery Services benefits for the PAR provider
steps.description: Click View Benefits on the same Professional row under Surgery Service. A dialog titled Service level opens and lists the place-of-service options. The provider you noted under Who is an Ambulatory Surgery Center, so locate the Ambulatory Surgical Center entry, which has two options, both listed as Ambulatory Surgical Center. Open each option's triangle and use the Network column to tell them apart: the option showing PAR is the benefit for this PAR provider. It shows an individual deductible of $3,000.00 (PINDED), a family deductible of $6,000.00 (PFMDED), coinsurance of 90.00%, and Y for the deductibles and coinsurance included in OOP, the adjudication indicator and the benefit covered indicator. The other option shows NPAR, with a $3,500.00 individual deductible, a $6,500.00 family deductible and 80.00% coinsurance. So the member pays the $3,000.00 individual or the $6,000.00 family deductible, whichever is met first; after that the plan covers 90% of the allowed amount and the member pays 10% as coinsurance. Close the dialog.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Ambulatory Surgical Center option whose Network column reads PAR is opened. The NPAR option and the other options complete nothing.
steps.hint: View Benefits on Surgery Service → Professional → open both Ambulatory Surgical Center options → the one showing PAR is the benefit.
steps.checklistItem: Review the Surgery Services benefits for the PAR provider

steps.name: Review the Out-of-Pocket limits
steps.description: Click + next to Plan Level on the same Benefits sub-tab, then scroll to the Out-of-pocket table to check the out-of-pocket limits for this service. The provider is PAR, so read only the PAR rows: the individual OOP limit is $3,500.00 and the family OOP limit is $7,000.00 (the NPAR limits are $6,000.00 and $12,000.00). You already reviewed the deductible limits under the service-level benefit, so they need no second look.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Plan Level is opened.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → + Plan Level → Out-of-pocket: PAR $3,500.00 individual, $7,000.00 family.

steps.name: Review the accrued deductible
steps.description: Now check how much of the deductible and OOP limits the member has already accrued. In the Accumulators section of the same sub-tab, open the DEDUCTIBLE group. For the benefit year 01/01/2026 – 12/31/2026 it shows INDIVIDUAL DED PAR 3000.00, INDIVIDUAL DED NONPAR 1392.87, FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE PAR 6000.00 and FAMILY DEDUCTIBLE NONPAR 2380.51. The provider is PAR, so only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the DEDUCTIBLE accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → DEDUCTIBLE. PAR: individual 3000.00, family 6000.00.

steps.name: Review the accrued Out-of-Pocket
steps.description: Open the OUT OF POCKET group in the Accumulators section. For the same period it shows INDIVIDUAL OOP PAR 3500.00, INDIVIDUAL OOP NONPAR 1392.87, FAMILY OOP PAR 7000.00 and FAMILY OOP NONPAR 2380.51. Again, only the PAR rows apply.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the OUT OF POCKET accumulator group is expanded.
steps.hint: Benefits sub-tab → Accumulators → OUT OF POCKET. PAR: individual 3500.00, family 7000.00.

steps.name: Calculate the benefits to apply
steps.description: Summarise what you found and work out the benefits for line 1, then open the Claim Lines tab, where they will be applied. Claim: bill charge $1,500.00, allowed $800.00, write-off $700.00. Benefits: individual deductible $3,000.00, family deductible $6,000.00, coinsurance 90%. OOP limits: individual $3,500.00, family $7,000.00. Accrued: individual deductible 3000.00, family deductible 6000.00, individual OOP 3500.00, family OOP 7000.00. Remaining deductible: individual $3,000.00 − 3000.00 = $0.00; family $6,000.00 − 6000.00 = $0.00. Remaining OOP: individual $3,500.00 − 3500.00 = $0.00; family $7,000.00 − 7000.00 = $0.00. The member has already met both the individual deductible and the individual out-of-pocket maximum, so no deductible and no coinsurance can be applied. The benefit counts the deductible and the coinsurance toward the OOP (IND DEDUCTIBLE INCLUDED IN OOP and COINSURANCE INCLUDED IN OOP read Y), and once the OOP maximum is met the member owes nothing more for the benefit year: the member pays nothing on this line, and the entire $800.00 allowed amount is paid. Only the write-off and the deductible are updated on line 1, each with its EOB code: PX_00066 for the $700.00 write-off and PX_00038 for the $0.00 deductible.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Lines tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Deductible and OOP maximum are both met, so the member owes nothing: EOB PX_00066 for the $700.00 write-off, PX_00038 for the $0.00 deductible, and $800.00 paid.

steps.name: Validate and confirm the applied benefits
steps.description: With the amounts worked out, click the Validate button on the claim summary. The system then applies the benefits to the claim automatically, and the values change on the Claim Lines tab you are already on. Check that the amounts and EOB codes Validate applied match your calculation: Line 1 — Benefits now shows EOB PX_00066 with a write-off of $700.00, EOB PX_00038 with a deductible of $0.00, no coinsurance or copay EOB, $800.00 paid, and the Benefit rule SURGPROF - PROFFESIONAL. These values appear only after Validate.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is clicked on the claim summary bar.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Then read Line 1 — Benefits on the Claim Lines tab.
steps.checklistItem: Validate and confirm the applied amounts and EOB codes
steps.completionToast: Benefits applied to line 1 — write-off and deductible posted, allowed amount paid in full.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Once the benefits are applied and confirmed, pay the claim. Choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
